checks.check: Allowed/forbidden lifecycle matrix and stale revision tests enforce exact predecessor/current-pointer rules.
checks.evidence: guards.ts enforces generation, expected revision, exact predecessor and matching current/revision snapshots. store-guards.test.ts:64–89 tests stale generations/revisions and missing history; lines 120–140 check all 42 lifecycle pairs and reason constraints. Daemon reports these tests passed.

checks.check: Duplicate keys, dangling/cross-scope references, oversized rows and reserved generated kinds fail before native mutation.
checks.evidence: snapshotPlan uses bounded row snapshots, rejects duplicate row IDs and reserves generated-row capacity; control/receipt effects are forbidden. guardEffects resolves references within the exact namespace/epoch and checks admitted scope. Tests exercise duplicate/oversized/reserved rows, missing dependencies and incompatible scopes. Both functions perform validation without native mutation.
The mapped snapshot test exercises immutable copies, malformed rows, duplicate keys, generated control rows, byte/row bounds and incompatible profiles.
The mapped test supplies SQL-like project/branch/epoch strings, requires hash-only predicates, rejects malformed row IDs and checks scope/epoch mismatches.

Mapped tests cover stale preconditions, missing references/history, altered immutable sources, provenance mismatches, exact tombstone protection, self-supersession rejection and required forget markers.
Mapped tests reject a missing source admittedAt field and unknown payload fields, and exercise source identity, attribution, timestamps, content hashes, spans and evidence completeness.
Mapped tests exercise the complete status matrix, reason restrictions, terminal-state rejection, carried evidence/vector preservation, paired supersession and logical forgetting.

The two daemon-mapped tests only exercise plan profile mismatches and evidence-only vector preservation. Neither reopens a store nor prepares or executes a query. A relevant test exists in store-initialization.test.ts ('store-initialization-reopened-profile-prepares-matching-plan-and-native-query'), but that file was not run in the supplied daemon results.

verdict.reason: The implementation satisfies both acceptance checks, but the required reopen/plan/query compatibility test is not established by the daemon-mapped tests.
